title: Mango Roll-Ups
description: Retro fruit roll-ups made from blended fresh mango, lemon juice and honey, dried in a low oven for 3–4 hours. No added sugar.
steps: Preheat the oven to 100°C/80°C fan. Line a large baking sheet with greaseproof paper pressed into corners.
Peel and de-stone the mango, blending all the fruit with the lemon juice and honey until smooth.
Tip on to the lined sheet and smooth to a thin even layer (2–3mm thick) with a palette knife.
Bake at low heat for 3–4 hours until fully dried out and pliable.
While still warm, place another sheet of greaseproof paper on top and peel the mixture off the base sheet. Trim edges with a knife, then roll into a cylinder and snip into 5 pieces.
notes: Makes 5 roll-ups. Per roll-up estimate. Keeps for around a week. Also works with pineapple, apple or mixed berries.
